rationale: Base mode choice: 100 units of a 2-8C product from A to B in 40 days on a 60,000 USD budget. Ocean is cheapest but its only feasible sailing leaves 1.7 days of slack, so under realistic ocean delays it is late most of the time; sea-air via DXB costs more and is almost always on time.
falsifier: Refuted if the cost-optimal plan is not ocean-only, or if its on-time probability is 0.5 or higher, or if the risk-adjusted plan is the cost-optimal plan.
